composition.serve_who: Sheet 21/27 (AFT PLC, section AFT) shows three WAGO 750-508 2DO modules (POS.13/14/15, CPU 750-8213) each driving two solenoid coils via a Connector Type I to field equipment. POS.13 (DO-03) explicitly labels its two channels "transom door CLOSE (EV 10.1A)" and "transom door OPEN (EV 10.1B)" — serves 260-transom-door. POS.14 (DO-04) labels its channels "deck door OPEN (EV 10.2A)" and "deck door CLOSE (EV 10.2B)" — serves 260-deck-door. POS.15 (DO-05) labels its channels "mainsheet traveler TO PORT (EV 10.3A)" and "mainsheet traveler TO STBD (EV 10.3B)" — per engineer-confirmed mapping "mainsheet traveller" -> 840-cariboni-hydraulic-cylinders. The rack/coupler common structure (module positions, CPU, bus terminals A1/A2, connector type reference to sheet 4) is shared PLC infrastructure, not tied to one piece of equipment.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: DO-03 module (POS.13) channel labels explicitly name 'transom door CLOSE' and 'transom door OPEN' with EV 10.1A/10.1B tags, directly matching the register's Transom Door node.

functions.label: Transom door CLOSE command
functions.what_it_does: PLC digital output energises the CLOSE solenoid valve coil to drive the transom door hydraulic actuator to close the door.

flow_scenarios.path: DO-03 CH01 output at 0V — no current to EV 10.1A coil — transom door hydraulics hold last position, door stationary.
Channel 1 of module position 13 in the AFT PLC rack energises EV 10.1A → solenoid valve shifts → hydraulic flow directed to close-side of transom door cylinder → transom door closes.

facts: Three WAGO 750-508 2-channel digital output (2DO) modules mounted in a WAGO 750-8213 CPU rack, at positions POS.13, POS.14, POS.15, labeled DO-03, DO-04, DO-05 respectively.
Each module has A1/A2 bus/power terminals feeding two output channels (CH01, CH02), each with +/- polarity pairs and an earth/ground terminal before reaching field wiring.
Each module's two channel outputs route to a 4-pin circular 'Connector Type I' field connector (pins 1-4); connector construction/pinout detailed on sheet 4 (not this sheet).
No local switches, fuses, or breakers are shown for individual valve circuits — control originates purely from PLC digital outputs.
No alarm/monitoring taps shown on this sheet.
Rev 4 (05/05/2026) note: 'SUBSTITUTE WINCHES MODULES FROM DIGITAL TO ANALOG' — indicates winches were removed from this digital-output scheme elsewhere; not directly depicted on this sheet.

uncertainties: No node in the register index specifically represents the AFT PLC rack/coupler/CPU 750-8213 infrastructure itself; infrastructure facts recorded without a target_node_id.

Sheet does not show wet/hydraulic-side data (pressures, cylinder sizes, relief settings) for transom door, deck door, or mainsheet traveller actuators — only electrical DO wiring to solenoid coils; dry_data limited to module/channel/connector info only.
